punchline: Hide a triangle of 2s in a page of 5s and someone who sees numbers in colour will find it before you do.
thirty_sec: Some people see printed numbers in colour, and scientists doubted it was real. V.S. Ramachandran printed a grid of 5s with a few 2s forming a triangle. Most of us have to hunt for it. People with number-colour synesthesia saw the 2s in a different colour and spotted the triangle fast. His explanation is that the brain areas for number shapes and for colour sit side by side and cross-activate.
